name: PdfDing
description: Self-hosted PDF manager, viewer and editor offering a seamless user experience on multiple devices.

paths.name: Database Path
paths.description: Path to the SQLite database folder. Remove if using Postgres. May need to update write permissions.

variables.name: Theme
variables.description: Theme

variables.name: Theme Color
variables.description: Theme color

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Used for securing signed data. Should be to a large random value.

variables.name: Host Name
variables.description: The host/domain name where PdfDing will be reachable.

variables.name: Require User Email Verification
variables.description: Block users until they have verified their email address.

variables.name: Disable User Signups
variables.description: Disable user signups

variables.name: Database - Type
variables.description: Database type

variables.name: Database - Host
variables.description: Postgres database host. Remove if using SQLite.

variables.name: Database - Port
variables.description: Postgres database port. Remove if using SQLite.

variables.name: Database - Password
variables.description: Postgres database password. Remove if using SQLite.

variables.name: OIDC - Enable
variables.description: Enable OpenID Connect

variables.name: OIDC - Provider Name
variables.description: OpenID Connect provider name

variables.name: OIDC - Client ID
variables.description: OpenID Connect client ID

variables.name: OIDC - Client Secret
variables.description: OpenID Connect client secret

variables.name: OIDC - Auth URL
variables.description: OpenID Connect authorization URL

variables.name: OIDC - Enforce
variables.description: Require users to use OIDC

variables.name: Email - Backend
variables.description: Whether to send account related emails, e.g a password reset or account verification, to the console or via an SMTP server.

variables.name: Email - SMTP Host
variables.description: SMTP server host. Remove if using the console backend.

variables.name: Email - SMTP Port
variables.description: SMTP server port. Remove if using the console backend.

variables.name: Email - SMTP User
variables.description: SMTP server user. Remove if using the console backend.

variables.name: Email - SMTP Password
variables.description: SMTP server password. Remove if using the console backend.

variables.name: Email - SMTP TLS
variables.description: Secure the connection to the SMTP server with TLS. Remove if using the console backend.

variables.name: Email - SMTP SSL
variables.description: Secure the connection to the SMTP server with SSL. Remove if using the console backend.

variables.name: Consumption - Enable
variables.description: Enable the consumption folder as an alternative way for adding PDFs.

variables.name: Consumption - Skip Existing
variables.description: Skip the addition PDF files if the user already has PDF with the same name and file size.

variables.name: Consumption - Tags
variables.description: Comma separated list of tags to add to the PDFs added via the consumption folder.

variables.name: Backups - Enable
variables.description: Enable periodic backups to S3 compatible storage.

variables.name: Backups - S3 Endpoint
variables.description: S3 compatible storage endpoint. Remove if not using backups.

variables.name: Backups - S3 Access Key
variables.description: S3 compatible storage access key. Remove if not using backups.

variables.name: Backups - S3 Secret Key
variables.description: S3 compatible storage secret key. Remove if not using backups.

variables.name: Backups - S3 Bucket
variables.description: S3 compatible storage bucket. Remove if not using backups.

variables.name: Backups - Schedule
variables.description: Cron schedule for the backups. Default is midnight every day.

variables.name: Backups - Secure
variables.description: Secure the connection to the S3 compatible storage with TLS.

variables.name: Backups - Encryption
variables.description: Encrypt the backups before uploading them to the S3 compatible storage.

variables.name: Backups - Encryption Password
variables.description: Password to encrypt the backups. Remove if not using encryption.

variables.name: Backups - Encryption Salt
variables.description: Salt to encrypt the backups. Remove if not using encryption.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log level

variables.name: Secure CSRF Cookie
variables.description: Set this to TRUE to avoid transmitting the CSRF cookie over HTTP accidentally.

variables.name: Secure Session Cookie
variables.description: Set this to TRUE to avoid transmitting the session cookie over HTTP accidentally.

variables.name: Secure SSL Redirects
variables.description: Redirects all non-HTTPS requests to HTTPS. If PdfDing is running behind a reverse proxy this can cause infinite redirects.

variables.name: Secure HSTS Seconds
variables.description: See details: https://github.com/mrmn2/PdfDing/blob/master/docs/configuration.md#secure_hsts_seconds

variables.name: Default Protocol for Account
variables.description: The default protocol for account related URLs, e.g. for the password forgotten procedure.

variables.name: Internal Server Port
variables.description: The port where the internal server is reachable. Not recommended to change.
